featuredCharacters.description: Electricity and the everyday devices and media powered by it.
The hand, and by extension things done or used by hand.
Heart in both the physical and emotional sense.
A mouth or opening; often appears in words about speech and entrances.
Water and things directly related to water.
Fire, heat, and several established compounds built with 火.
Up, above, on, or moving into an activity or place.
Books, reading, and written materials.
Teeth and dental vocabulary.
Rain and weather related to rain.

The sea and places or things associated with it.
Vehicles, riding, driving, and transport-related vocabulary.
Money and common actions involving money.

Clothes and clothing-related vocabulary.
Meals, cooked rice, and everyday eating vocabulary.
Dishes, vegetables, ordering, and food-shopping vocabulary.
Learning, school, students, and levels of education.
People, roles, family members, and nationalities.
Days, weather, and the seasons.
Down/below, getting off, finishing activities, and weather verbs.
Home, family, and everyday expressions built around 家.
Doors, entrances, and common door-related expressions.
Roads, routes, walking, directions, and people along the way.

The moon and the calendar month, including time, light, food, and salary expressions.
The sun and the day, including dates, schedules, holidays, and written records.
Front, before, and former — used for direction, time, positions, and previous relationships.
Back and after — used for position, direction, time, order, and results.
Small and little, including everyday words for children, neighborhoods, snacks, quiet voices, novels, and caution.
Big and large, including adults, university, entrances, everyone, growing up, enlarging, and size.
Female and woman, with words for girls, women, daughters, girlfriends, women's clothing, and admired women.
Male and man, with words for boys, men, boyfriends, men and women, men's clothing, and admired men.
Old and elder, plus common 老 words for family, hometown, professions, birth order, animals, and foreigners.
Good, pleasant, enjoyable, or easy, with common words for people, food, drinks, appearance, sound, fun, and handling tasks.
To eat, plus common expressions about food, taste, surprise, loss, jealousy, and hardship.
Looking, watching, seeing, understanding, opinions, judgments, and thinking highly of something.
Birth, life, growth, rawness, unfamiliarity, and words for different kinds of people.
Work, labor, workers, jobs, workplaces, wages, technical trades, and starting or finishing work.
Time, duration, frequency, punctuality, temporary situations, and time differences.
